name: Tenacious Illusions
body:
Illusions you cast are hard to dispel.

Prerequisites: Spell Focus (Illusion)

Benefit: The DC of caster level checks to dispel or remove your illusions increases by 2; even if the spell is dispelled, it persists for 1 more round before dissipating.
